verdict.rationale: HMRC's own gov.uk pages say the core registrations can be done online. These include the 'register for VAT online service', employer (PAYE) registration where 'most limited companies can register online', and sign-up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax via 'the online service'. Corporation Tax can be managed online once it is added to the business tax account. Missing for 10: no published evidence that tax payments can be made online; Corporation Tax return filing is only implied by 'manage online', not stated; Income Tax filing depends on third-party compatible software; employer registration is caveated to 'most' companies; and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration that the transactions complete end to end.
